enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulders. Adjust pillow under head. Remain still. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Snore lightly. Wake briefly, check clock. Turn over. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap and light. Walk to bedroom and get dressed.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog along the neighbourhood streets
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up leash. Attach leash to dog's collar. Open front door. Walk out. Close door. Walk along sidewalk. Stop at corner. Wait for dog to sniff. Pull leash gently. Continue walking. Turn right at intersection. Walk past park. Greet neighbor. Stop to let dog urinate. Pick up waste with bag. Continue walking. Turn around. Walk back home. Open front door. Remove leash. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast and taking morning medication
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out eggs, milk, butter. Close refrigerator. Take out bread and place in toaster. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Melt butter in pan. Pour eggs into pan. Scramble eggs. Turn off stove. Remove toast. Put eggs on plate. Set plate on table. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Take morning medication with water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food scraps into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load cups and utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with sponge. Rinse sink. Dry hands with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting, washing and folding clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter laundry room. Turn on light. Open hamper. Sort clothes into whites and colors. Pick up whites. Load into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Set cycle to normal. Press start. Wait for cycle to finish. Open washing machine. Transfer clothes to dryer. Set dryer. Press start. Wait for dryer. Remove clothes. Fold clothes. Put folded clothes in basket. Carry basket to bedroom. Put clothes in drawers.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet prayer, reading and journaling at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Kneel beside bed. Bow head. Close eyes. Move lips in prayer. Make sign of cross. Stand up. Sit at desk. Open Bible. Read silently. Turn page. Close Bible. Open journal. Pick up pen. Write in journal. Close journal. Put pen down.

enriched_activities.activity: One-on-one text check-ins with relatives and neighbours
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select relative's contact. Type message: 'Good morning, how are you?' Send message. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response: 'Glad to hear.' Send. Select neighbour's contact. Type message: 'Hello, checking in.' Send. Read reply. Type response. Send. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Batch cooking and meal prep for the coming week
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash and chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Heat pan. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Portion into containers. Label containers. Place in refrigerator. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Set table. Bring food from kitchen. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Pick up plate. Carry plate to kitchen. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table. Return to dining room. Push chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing remote paperwork and the community outreach list on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Open document. Review paperwork. Open community outreach list. Read list. Make notes on paper. Pick up pen. Write notes. Close document. Turn off computer. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Collecting a prescription refill at the pharmacy and paying with cash budget
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to pharmacy. Open door. Walk to counter. Stand in queue. Hand prescription to pharmacist. Wait. Receive medication. Open wallet. Take out cash. Count cash. Hand cash to pharmacist. Receive change. Count change. Put change in wallet. Put medication in bag. Walk out of pharmacy. Open door. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping on a cash budget
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce aisle. Select vegetables. Place in basket. Walk to dairy aisle. Select milk. Place in basket. Walk to meat aisle. Select chicken. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Place items on conveyor belt. Pay cash. Count change. Put change in wallet. Bag items. Exit store.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up leash. Attach leash to dog's collar. Open door. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Stop to let dog sniff. Pull leash gently. Continue walking. Let dog run in open area. Call dog back. Attach leash. Walk out of park. Return home. Open door. Remove leash. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Dropping off community outreach notices at the local community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to community centre. Open door. Walk to reception. Greet staff. Hand notices. Discuss distribution. Ask about upcoming events. Thank staff. Read notice board. Walk out. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking public transit home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on comfortable clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Heat pan. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Carry plate to dining room.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Set table. Bring food from kitchen. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Carry plate to kitchen. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table. Return to dining room. Push chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: One-on-one text check-ins with relatives and neighbours
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select relative's contact. Type message: 'How was your day?' Send message. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type response: 'That's good.' Send. Select neighbour's contact. Type message: 'Hello, checking in.' Send. Read reply. Type response. Send. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the kitchen and preparing lunch for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wipe counters. Wash dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients for lunch. Close refrigerator. Prepare lunch. Place lunch in container. Close container. Store in refrigerator. Wipe table. Sweep floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Short evening dog walk around the block
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up leash. Attach leash to dog's collar. Open door. Walk around block. Stop to let dog sniff. Continue walking. Return home. Open door. Remove leash. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, washing up and taking evening medication
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Take medication. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulders. Adjust pillow under head. Remain still. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Snore lightly. Wake briefly, check clock. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
